source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original 1647 first edition Wellcome b30338724
title: Of the Parents mutuall love to the Native, and which of his Parents shall best love him
scope: Historical relationship testimony plus Regiomontanus-attributed father chart reconstruction; no actual father birth-time recovery established.

source_groups.source_group: Printed CXXVI and parental-affection scope with natal input

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXVI Of the Parents mutuall love to the Native
clauses.historical_only_meaning: This independent chapter asks which parent most loves the native; unlike prior CXXV's parent-to-parent concord.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: which of his Parents shall best love him
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The output is relative parent-to-native affection rather than an overall marital harmony score.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: generall Significators first to be considered
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly invokes the parental significator selection before judging either parent's affection.

source_groups.source_group: Day father Sun/mother Moon; night father Saturn/mother Moon

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in a diurnall Nativity
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Day-birth rules require the chart to be diurnal.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: for Father Sun
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Sun is the source father significator in a daytime nativity.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: for Mother Moon
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The first-edition glyph names Moon as mother indicator in daylight, not Venus in this chapter's opening.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: In a nocturnall Nativity
clauses.historical_only_meaning: A separate night-specific indicator selection applies.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: for the Father Saturn
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Saturn is substituted for Sun as the father significator at night.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: for the Mother Moon
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The Moon remains a source mother significator in the nocturnal case.

source_groups.source_group: Friendly configurations to Ascendant or first ruler

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: behold Lord of the first
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Favorable aspects are evaluated to the ruler of the natal Ascendant, not only between the parents.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or the Horoscope it self
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The Ascendant itself is an alternative target of favorable aspects.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: with a Sextile aspect
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Sextile is named as one favorable contact.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Trine aspect
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Trine is another favorable contact distinct from sextile.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: love and concord betwixt Native and Parents
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly alleges parent–child affection/concord under the favorable aspect patterns, without human observation.

source_groups.source_group: Harsh square/opposition between parent significators and first ruler

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: cast their Square to Lord of ascendant
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The selected parent significators square the first ruler in one hostile relationship branch.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Opposition to Lord of ascendant
clauses.historical_only_meaning: An opposition is the separate alleged hostile aspect alternative.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: much discord to arise betwixt them
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The author predicts parent–child discord from these contacts; no independently measured relationship outcome.

source_groups.source_group: Relative mother vs father love and reception

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon or Venus Sextile to Lord of Ascendant
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Moon or Venus sextile is a possible basis for the mother's alleged stronger affection.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Trine to Lord of Ascendant
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Moon/Venus trine supplies another favorable relative-mother branch.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: and not Saturn or Sun
clauses.historical_only_meaning: To infer stronger maternal affection, favorable father significator aspects are expressly absent.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mother will best affect the Native
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly claims the mother loves the native most under this asymmetric planetary testimony.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: contrary aspects happen
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The text says to reason contrariwise when the aspect pattern reverses, without defining a numerical tie rule.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: mutuall reception betwixt Lord of ascendant and either
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Reception between first ruler and either parent significator is a distinct method of choosing the allegedly more affectionate parent.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: observe with whom the reception is
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The favored parent is assigned by which significator actually receives or is received by the first ruler.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Native shall have most affection
clauses.historical_only_meaning: A relative parent affection conclusion is asserted under the reception method, with no demonstrated accuracy.

source_groups.source_group: Regiomontanus attribution, historical popularity and non-cusp daytime precondition

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Regiomontanus ... extract the Fathers Nativity from Sonnes
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly attributes a father-nativity extraction method to Regiomontanus rather than presenting it as a measured family case.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in Problem 24
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The author specifically points to Regiomontanus Problem 24; original text not independently compared yet.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: much used by some excellent Astrologians
clauses.historical_only_meaning: An alleged history of practitioner use is not evidence of birth-time recovery accuracy.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: If the Geniture be by day
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly's printed numerical construction has a diurnal nativity precondition.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun not upon cusp of tenth or fourth
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Sun on Midheaven or IC cusp is expressly excluded; the source gives no fallback case there.

source_groups.source_group: Regiomontanus Sun positional circle and pole; proposed father Ascendant

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: take his Circle of position
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Sun's positional circle is required as a geometrical input.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: under that Pole
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The pole of Sun's positional circle is needed for oblique-ascension calculations, not simply local geographic latitude.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: degree of Sun be your ascendant
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Within the proposed father-figure construction, Lilly assigns the Sun's ecliptic longitude to the derived Ascendant.

source_groups.source_group: Oblique ascension under Sun pole to Midheaven right ascension

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: oblique ascention of Sun
clauses.historical_only_meaning: An oblique ascension under the selected positional pole is the input to the angular subtraction.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: substract 90 degrees
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly subtracts 90 degrees from Sun's oblique ascension, an explicit arithmetic transform.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: gives right ascention of Mid heaven
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The subtraction result is interpreted as the proposed Midheaven's right ascension, not directly its ecliptic longitude.

source_groups.source_group: Regiomontanus house poles, 30-degree increments and ecliptic mapping

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: see what the Poles of other houses are
clauses.historical_only_meaning: House-specific poles are required for completing the hypothetical father figure.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: by Regiomontanus page 175
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The source references an earlier house-pole table/method by Regiomontanus at page 175; not independently reconciled here.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: continuall addition of 30 degrees to right ascention
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Successive right-ascension increments of 30 degrees are described as a step in constructing cusps.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: what degree of the Ecliptick answers to oblique ascention
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The computed oblique ascension is inverted to an ecliptic degree under the applicable pole; no complete numerical table is transcribed here.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: cusps of eleventh twelfth second third
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly names the four non-angular house cusps derived from the repeated operations.

source_groups.source_group: Derived chart claim and placing planets; boundary to mines

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: then the Figure is as easily erected
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The author claims that the father figure can be erected from those cusps; this is not independent recovery of an actual father birth time.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: as by having true place of Nativity
clauses.historical_only_meaning: The phrase compares ease with knowing the natal place, not a verified equality of actual birth moments.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: place all your Planets therein accordingly
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Lilly instructs placing planets into the constructed chart, but supplies no actual father date, time or independent positional verification.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXVII significations ... Fortune out of Mines
clauses.historical_only_meaning: After the end of the Regiomontanus paragraph, printed CXXVII starts on PDF609 as a separate wealth-from-mines chapter.

clauses.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: When Saturn is Lord of the fourth house
clauses.historical_only_meaning: Only the opening of the next mining source is retained as navigation; its mining rules are not included in CXXVI.
